bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state lands; prohibiting acquisition of land for flood control or water retention under certain circumstances; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 16B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[16B.2971] ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY PROHIBITED; FLOOD CONTROL AND WATER RETENTION. +]

[+(a) An agency or nonprofit organization may not acquire real property in fee or by easement for the purpose of a flood control or water retention project if the state owns land within the project area. +]

[+(b) For the purposes of this section, a "flood control or water retention project" is a project with the primary purpose to hold water on the land or otherwise prevent flooding. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state lands; prohibiting acquisition of land for flood control or water retention under certain circumstances; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 16B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[16B.2971] ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY PROHIBITED; FLOOD CONTROL AND WATER RETENTION.

(a) An agency or nonprofit organization may not acquire real property in fee or by easement for the purpose of a flood control or water retention project if the state owns land within the project area.

(b) For the purposes of this section, a "flood control or water retention project" is a project with the primary purpose to hold water on the land or otherwise prevent flooding.
additions: [16B.2971] ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY PROHIBITED; FLOOD CONTROL AND WATER RETENTION.

(b) For the purposes of this section, a "flood control or water retention project" is a project with the primary purpose to hold water on the land or otherwise prevent flooding.
